translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Yoni Tobafitaiso Yesu yana ela faꞋina givenuwaꞋata.
VenuwaꞋata Yamumuna Yesu Keliso Yaubada Natuna faꞋina hidede amine.
Tuwai-moꞋena Yaubada bonana ana toꞋawatalatalaina ana egana Aiseya gahe saꞋeyana giꞋetoladina. Yaubada yana gahe Natuna againe giꞋetoladina gigayo,
Hidedemi Aiseya gigahe.

Ada gavaimi tuwai-moꞋena Aiseya gigaheye-vagahina, medemi gilakayemu velemoꞋena. FaꞋina Yoni walaꞋaiya yana ivemogatala gilakayemu gilulumamala gigayo, “Yami dewa koyona wanavenikohiyena be wanahagavilami-yo wanabafitaiso be Yaubada yami koyona ginayawelina.” Hidedemi Yoni gilulumamala.
Kaliva moyaꞋaidi Yudiya ana fafali kadu Yelusalema againe hitauya be hina Yoni yana laumamala hinanogalina. Yadi dewa koyona hiyau-yo gufa ana egana Yolidani againe gikivebafitaisoyedi.

Bana Yoni ma yana miyami kaliva koyokoyo-Ꞌavana amine. Aikeva kameli utuutuna againe hiyogona-ma giꞋosena ada gaiyona bulumakau kwafiline hiyogona ma goline gihifona. Ada anaga ma koloma kadu maꞋawa gufadi amine.

Ada gilulumamala gigayo, “Iya wai ganagona tu kaliva saꞋeyana wai ginamulina-ma gifaiwalahegeku. Bana kikaiwabu-moꞋena tu iya kwamana kabisoku faꞋina, keke akufaiweya Bana againe ganaveꞋagetoga be ganaꞋaiboꞋula-yo ana ageyafayafa adi abaꞋaiyauga ganayauni.
Iya gufa againe gakivebafitaisoyemi tu BanaꞋe ma AluꞋaluwa Mahalina againe ginakivebafitaisoyemi be ginavemagami.” Hidedemi Yoni gilulumamala.
Yesu gibafitaiso tu Setani giꞋaladibidibiyena.
Himiyami tu Yesu Nasaledi Galili ana fafaliya gitauya be Yoni againe giꞋela, ada Yoni Yolidani againe gikivebafitaisoyena.
Ada Yesu gibafitaiso gihavaina, gufeya giꞋaꞋalakahini tu auheꞋama lobama giꞋayavalini-yo Yaubada AluꞋaluwana ana ita vaita bunebune amine Bana againe gihobuꞋela ma giꞋitana.
Ada Yaubada agona lobameya gikova gigayo, “OꞋeni natuꞋaseꞋaseku, nuwaku ukiveyamumu-moꞋena.”
Yesu Yolidani againe gibafitaiso tu auheꞋama AluꞋaluwa Mahalina babigaga againe giwavina.
Ada aiyeta foti agaidiya babigaga againe gimiyami tu Setani giꞋalaꞋaladibidibiyena. Ada kevakeva walawalaꞋa hinafadiya gimiyami keke tamo kaliva tu lobama ana tovenuwaꞋata hiꞋela hiꞋitaveꞋavina.
Yesu tobayauma gikovadi be hinavetomuliya.

Tu Yesu Yoni valeyana ginogalina higa deliya hisena. Ada hidedemi ginogalini-yo gilowoga fafali ana egana Galili againe gina be Yaubada yana VenuwaꞋata Yamumuna gilulumamalena gigayo, “Yaubada yana aituha a gilakayemu. Tova kabisona kaliva yana itaveꞋavina againe hinamiyami be aseꞋasediya ginavehivehimeya. Au yami dewa koyona wanavenikohiyeni-yo wanahagavilami be VenuwaꞋata Yamumuna wanavetumaganena.” Hidedemi Yesu gilulumamala.
Tova saꞋeyana Yesu tobu ana egana Galili ana taliyeya ginauna tu Saimoni kadu taina Anidulu giꞋitadi. Alevatu hisesehobuyeni tu giꞋitadi faꞋina badi tobayauma.
Ada Yesu gigahedi gigayo, “WaꞋela wanamuliyeku be kaliva adi bayauma ganavehawalemi.”
Ada auheꞋama kaliva adiꞋiselu yadi alevatu hisehobuye-vagahini tu himuliyena.
Kadu ginauna tu matalaviseya Yemesa wataina Yoni Sebedi natuneyao giꞋitadi, wakeya hihiyoto yadi alevatu giꞋakaninina-ma hikikidewedewena.
Ada auheꞋama gikovadi be hinamuliyena. Au tamadi Sebedi yana tofaisewa buye wakeya himiyami-ma hinuyabuyabudi be Yesu himuliyena.
Yesu kaliva wayafunena gikiveyamumuna.
Hinauna tu Kafeneumi againe hiyemu. Ada sabati againe Yesu manuwa-abavehawala ana egana sinagogi againe giluku givebutu givehawala.
Ada yoꞋo yana vehawala faꞋina hiyaulowoga higayo, “Keke Mosese yana vehimeya ana tovehawala amine gidavehawala, au vaita tovehimeya velemoꞋena amine givehavehawala, yana vehawala aseꞋaseda giꞋonana.”

Higahegahe tu kaliva wayafunena yadi sinagogi againe giluku gikovaꞋawafatafata gigayo, “Yesu kwanaNasaledi gavadi ime agaimeya unagani-yo uꞋela? KaꞋi O uꞋela be ime yafune ama loi unamunuma-yo anabwavi? O ya inuba gahalamanena. OꞋeni Yaubada yana Kaliva Mahamahali.”
Tu Yesu yafune gihawatana gigayo, “GiꞋalove. Una, kaliva unuyabuyabuni.”
Yafune kaliva gikivefavefanina toyogina gitatawayana-yo ginuyabuyabuna.
Kaliva moyaꞋaidi hiꞋita-yo hiyaulowoga-moꞋa buye hiveꞋagahegahe higayo, “Hida hima gavaꞋana? Yana vehawala tuli-moꞋena kadu ana wavehimeya. Yafune nonogana hida kaliva gihawatadi-ma bonana hiꞋabina.”
Ada au Yesu valeyana Galili ana fafali matatabuna againe giveꞋaliyahega.
Yesu toꞋaulolo moyaꞋaidi gisiveyawadi.
Tu Yesu manuwa-abavehawala againe gihobu-yo gina Saimoni Anidulu yadi manuweya. Ada Yemesa Yoni badi buye hina manuweya hiluku.
Saimoni lawana adi iviya hidauda wowodi vaita ai, ada badi faꞋidiya Yesu himaduvenuwaꞋatana.
Au gina giꞋitadi nimadiya giꞋabi be gisivemidididi. Wowodi auheꞋama gituluna ada hivebutu adi wakawaka adiga hikidewedewena.
Mala gibogi kauwana giholu-yo kaliva yadi toꞋaulolo moyaꞋaidi kadu wayafunediyao Yesu againe hiꞋaliyedi.

Melala ana kaliva moyaꞋaidi Saimoni yana edaꞋawaneya hivagaꞋauta-Ꞌowoga, ada Yesu toꞋaulolo moyaꞋaidi yadi aulolo tulina tulina ma gisiveyawadi. Kadu yafune moyaꞋaidi kaliva hiluvaiyedi-ma giwavidi, ada yafune Bana inubana hihalamanena faꞋina gihawatadi be keke hinalukahihiyeni.
Yesu Galili ana fafaliya gilulumamala.
Tu aiyeta anavelu mala aimo keke gidalauni tu Yesu giꞋenohobu be gina melalagaga saꞋeyana againe giveꞋoveꞋoꞋola.
Saimoni tobohiyaneyao buye hina hilelena ada hinuhagana againe higayo, “Kaliva moyaꞋaidi O hilelele.”
Yesu gigayo, “WaꞋela be kana mali melaleya be kadu badi agaidiya ganalulumamala. Hidema faꞋina gahobuꞋela.”
Ada au Galili ana melala moyaꞋaina agaidiya ginunuwaliliuga, yadi manuwa-abavehawala agaidiya gilulumamala, adi yafune giwaviwavidi.
Yesu tovedawodawowo gikiveyamumuna.
Tu tovedawodawowo saꞋeyana giꞋela Yesu againe tugana giveꞋetodonena be gihawayafeyafena gigayo, “KaꞋi nuwanuwa digo, afaiweya unakiveyamumuku.”
Gigahe-yo Yesu gihinekalikaliyena nimana gitunena kaliva giꞋabina gigayo, “Iya nuwanuwaku. Au unayamumu.”
Ada auheꞋama ana dawodawowo gihavaina be giyamumu.

Giyamumu tu Yesu gimaduꞋatuhegena ana hawata givelena gigayo, “Unogali. Keke tamo hakwadi unavenuwaꞋatani, au abaveyao ana tofaisewa againe unamaduna be wowo unavehawalena. Kadu ya yamumu faꞋina manuga luhei ada sifi, higa abaveyao Mosese boi tuwai-moꞋena givehimeyena amine ma unanauwedi be moyaꞋaidi o uyamumu velemoꞋena ma hinahalamanena.”

Atu kaliva gilowoga be gina yana yamumu valeyana givebutu kaliva moyaꞋaidi agaidiya gilukahihiyena, ada au valeyana ginauna. MoyaꞋaidi hiyoꞋoyoꞋo faꞋina, Yesu keke anafaiweya melaleya ginaluku kaliva matadiya. Au melalagaga agaidiya gimiyami. Atu kaliva melala tulina tulina agaidiya hitauya be Yesu againe hiyoꞋo.
